pages.text: Plant Fiddlehead on Rich Soil or Twilight Rich Soil and it will turn into a Fiddlehead Clump.$(br2)The clump grows through 4 stages on soil that supports colonies. Keep the space above empty so tall fronds can sprout, and use Bone Meal to speed it up.

Breaking a grown clump drops 2 to 5 Fiddleheads depending on its stage.$(br2)At full growth, harvest it with Shears to pick up the Clump itself, or cut it on a Cutting Board with a knife for 5 Fiddleheads.
